definition: An abstract, typically lower-dimensional space in which a model represents compressed, learned features of its input data.
details: Latent space representations capture underlying structure and relationships in data that may not be obvious in the raw input, and are central to how generative models like VAEs and diffusion models produce novel outputs.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Latent Space.
